question_text: A 27-year-old female is brought in by ambulance with altered mental status. She is in a comatose state, but is breathing spontaneously with deep and rapid respirations. Her vital signs are as follows: T 100.2F, BP 92/54 mmHg, HR 103 bpm, RR 28, and SpO2 97% on room air. Complete blood count reveals: WBC 12.7, hemoglobin 11.3, platelets 254. Basic metabolic panel reveals: sodium 137, potassium 4.2, chloride 100, bicarbonate 16, creatinine 1.78 An ABG is performed which showed pH 7.38, PaO2 94, PaCO2 26. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this patient’s presentation?
